name: Django REST framework
covers: Rerail's own Django REST framework rules, from the DRF docs and maintainers' review advice, for safe serializers, permissions, querysets and pagination.

rules.title: DRF practice: a handler that reads or changes its row itself, skipping the view's object permission

caught.text:
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework import viewsets
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response

from library.api.permissions import IsOwner
from library.models import Book


class BookViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Book.objects.all()
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsOwner]

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def archive(self, request, pk=None):
        book = get_object_or_404(Book, pk=pk)
        book.delete()
        return Response(status=204)

from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework import viewsets
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response

from library.api.permissions import IsOwner
from library.models import Book


class BookViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Book.objects.all()
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsOwner]

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def archive(self, request, pk=None):
        book = self.get_object()
        book.delete()
        return Response(status=204)

rules.title: DRF practice: read_only_fields or extra_kwargs naming a declared serializer field

caught.text:
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from rest_framework import serializers


class UserSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    username = serializers.CharField(max_length=150)

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = ["id", "username", "email"]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "username"]

passes.text:
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from rest_framework import serializers


class UserSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    username = serializers.CharField(max_length=150, read_only=True)

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = ["id", "username", "email"]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "username"]

from rest_framework import serializers, viewsets
from rest_framework.pagination import PageNumberPagination

from shop.models import Order


class OrderSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    class Meta:
        model = Order
        fields = ["id", "created"]


class OrderPagination(PageNumberPagination):
    page_size = 50
    max_page_size = 500


class OrderViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Order.objects.all()
    serializer_class = OrderSerializer
    pagination_class = OrderPagination
